title: Three equivalent characterisations of projective modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that projectivity, being a direct summand of a free module, and the vanishing of Ext one against every module are equivalent (statement lines 19011-19020). The proof does not quote the standard characterisations: it splits a surjection from a free module by the lifting property, uses that splitting to kill Ext one by a direct summand argument, and conversely exhibits the splitting of a presentation from the vanishing of Ext one (proof lines 19022-19060). Reading the vanishing of Ext one as the splitting of a presentation is the step that closes the cycle. H2.
